title: Customers
description: Your business's customer records: contact, notes, tags and message consent. Records are visible to this business only.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view customers.
load_failed: Customers could not be loaded. Try again.
empty_description: Add your first customer or import them from a file.
empty_filtered_description: Change the filters or clear the search.
create_description: Enter the customer's name, phone and message consent.
edit_description: Update the customer's contact details, notes and consent.
detail_description: The customer's contact details, notes, consent and history.
detail_not_found: Customer not found or you have no access.
columns.name: Name
verification.panel_link: the panel link in an SMS
verification.linked: The customer verified this phone with {{method}} on {{at}}.
verification.unlinked: The customer has not verified this phone yet. Numbers typed in the panel or imported never count as verified.
history.hidden: The customer's panel does not show this business's visits booked before {{at}}: the number may have changed hands or was not confirmed for a long time. The business's records stay.
history.requested: The customer asked from their panel on {{at}} to get the history back.
history.check_hint: If the customer really owns this record (you recognise them at the reception) you can reopen the history. A matching name alone is no evidence; only this business's history opens.
history.restore_description: Every earlier visit of {{name}} at this business will show in their panel again. Confirm only if you recognise the person; the action is written to the activity.
history.restored: The panel history was reopened on {{at}}.
history.restored_by: The panel history was reopened on {{at}} by {{by}}.
history.restored_toast: The customer's panel history was reopened.
fields.phone_hint: Without a country code the number is read as Turkish.
fields.phone_hint_verified: Changing the number removes the verification; the customer has to verify the new number.
fields.tags_hint: Separate with commas, for example: vip, regular
fields.notes_hint: Only this business's team sees them.
fields.sms_consent_hint: Commercial message consent for campaign and announcement SMS.
fields.email_consent_hint: Commercial message consent for campaign and announcement emails.

form.section_notes_desc: Notes that help the team know the customer, tags that filter the list.
form.section_consent_desc: Commercial message consent. Booking reminders do not depend on it.
